content.title: MML Fan Support - Category
content.text: Apple Products How do I log in with my TV provider on my mobile device? 1. Select the "Sign In" button from a live game video player or in the settings page.2. Choose from the list of providers (If your provider is not listed, select "View All TV Providers.") Why should I log in with my TV provider? You will be able to watch live games across TBS, TNT, truTV, and CBS with your 1 hour per day free preview period. Following the 1 hour free preview, you will be prompted on your device to log in with your TV provider to continue watching Will I have access to all games once I authenticate? Without being logged in, you should be able to view any game for 1 hour per day on your desktop, mobile, and connected devices. I am unable to log in to my tv provider in MML Mobile App. What steps can I take to solve this issue? Each user receives 60 minutes of Free Preview per day on their mobile devices before needing to enter their login credentials. A login is only required when watching a live game with no free preview time left or playing Bracket Challenge Do I need to sign in with my TV provider in order to watch live games on my Apple TV? You will be able to watch live games across TBS, TNT, truTV, and CBS with your 1 hour per day free preview period. Following the 1 hour free preview, you will be prompted on your device to log in with your TV provider to continue watching. Why am I unable to select my TV Provider on an iPhone device? Unable to select my TV Provider on an iPhone device? Can I sign into MML with my HBO Max Subscription? No, you can not sign into March Madness Live™ with a HBO Max Subscription. There are two ways to watch live video in March Madness Live: - Login with your TV Provider to watch live games. How can I sign in with my TV Provider - Get Access Model/Button You can Sign In with your TV Provider with our “Get Access” pop up in the GameCenter. Here you can sign in with your TV provider. How do I log in to my tv provider on my mobile device? "In order for you to log in to your tv provider on your mobile device, you must: 1. Tap on the 'Settings' tab at the bottom righthand corner of your mobile device and it will prompt you to sign in with your tv provider.
